claims.statement: The EHDS framework supports secure secondary use of health data for research and innovation, but key provisions apply gradually and require safeguards and authorized purposes.
European Commission GDPR guidance requires a lawful basis and applies additional constraints to sensitive health data, including explicit consent in some research settings.

contrary_evidence: The Commission says most EHDS obligations do not apply immediately and major secondary-use rules phase in later.
EHDS restricts purposes, requires safeguards, and prohibits some uses; it is not a general commercial data licence.

economics.acquisition_route: Clinician and university partnerships on supply; regulatory, CRO, and medtech channels on demand
economics.founder_net_worth_path: A possible path is a multi-clinic evidence network completing 15-25 studies annually with retained protocol and operations infrastructure, not ownership of patient data
economics.founder_time: Initially 15-20 hours per week, with clinical, privacy, and ethics leadership formally contracted
economics.gross_margin_basis: Expected 40-65% after clinic, participant, secure-compute, insurance, ethics, and scientific oversight costs
economics.payback: Unknown; one or two properly priced pilots might cover setup, but approval and sales cycles may be long
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 100000-500000 PLN per scoped observational or validation study plus per-participant costs
economics.retention_or_repeat: Sponsors may commission repeat studies; participant permissions are purpose-specific and revocable where applicable

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Trusted clinic agreements, repeat participant cohorts, protocol execution history, and harmonized longitudinal measures reduce future study setup cost
fingerprint.customer: European medtech, diagnostics, wearables, and health-AI developers needing real-world research evidence
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Begin with a narrow Warsaw clinical specialty through physician and university partners; sell to medtech via research and regulatory advisers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Clinic recruitment, protocol operations, consent and governance workflow, secure analysis, and aggregate research outputs with clinics and participants compensated
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The sponsor pays a setup fee, per-participant study fee, and analysis milestone fees under an approved protocol
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A developer needs a defined longitudinal cohort or external validation study but cannot recruit and govern multiple clinics efficiently

founder_fit: Combines neuroscience, biosignal, data-science, and health interests
The founder's medical-student partner may improve domain understanding but is not treated as a credential or channel
Secure analysis and automation are high-leverage
Can start with one non-interventional research use case
risks: A privacy breach could cause severe patient harm
Invalid consent or purpose creep could make processing unlawful
Biased cohorts or weak protocols could mislead sponsors
Clinical, ethics, medical-device, and insurance obligations may make this unsuitable for part-time operation

structure.control_point: Clinic access agreements and purpose-specific participant permissions for repeat longitudinal cohorts
structure.critical_dependency: A valid legal basis, approvals, secure processing, adequate cohort quality, and clinic participation must all be maintained

thesis: Build a network of independent clinics that grants study-execution and data-governance authority for defined research uses, recruit appropriately consented participants, and sell secure longitudinal evidence studies to medtech and diagnostic developers rather than exporting raw patient data.
title: Clinic-Partnered Longitudinal Evidence Network
uncertainties: No clinic, participant group, or sponsor has committed
Required Polish ethics and health-data approvals are unverified
EHDS implementation is gradual and does not create immediate commercial access
Study pricing, recruitment speed, and founder workload are unknown
